mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 10% over six months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy feels the effects.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over three months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 5% over six months signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenues grow.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a single month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence rises.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a single month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP by more than 1% over a quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
